CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 49
   C. 8
   D. 7

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 11

5. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 26

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 50

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 25
   C. 17
   D. 27

13. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

14. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 17

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 14
   C. 22
   D. 33

17. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

18. Solve for x: x + 6 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 18
   C. 6
   D. 13

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

20. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

22. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

23. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
